name: Lardr
tagline: The operating layer for multi-brand ghost kitchen networks.
positioning: Lardr gives enterprise food operators one system to launch delivery-only brands, route orders across shared kitchens, and cost every plate they ship.

hero.h1: Run every delivery brand from one kitchen stack.
hero.sub: Lardr connects your ghost kitchens, virtual brands, and delivery marketplaces so operations, menus, and unit economics live in a single system of record.

features.title: Multi-brand order routing
features.description: Ingest tickets from every marketplace and route them to the right station across shared kitchens, with prep timing that keeps expo lines from backing up.

features.title: Menu control tower
features.description: Publish, 86, and reprice items across all your virtual brands and delivery apps at once — no more editing the same burger in nine dashboards.

features.title: Plate-level costing
features.description: Every order is costed against live recipe and ingredient data, so finance sees true contribution margin per brand, per location, per hour.

features.title: Capacity forecasting
features.description: Predict station load by daypart and staff against it, using order history from each marketplace and brand you operate.

features.title: Marketplace reconciliation
features.description: Match every payout line to the orders behind it, flagging missing deposits, adjustment fees, and chargebacks before they hit your books.

features.title: Compliance-ready records
features.description: Retain menu versions, allergen data, and food-safety logs per location so audits and franchise reviews take hours, not weeks.

testimonials.quote: Before Lardr we ran six virtual brands out of three kitchens on spreadsheets and hope. Now our expo screens, menu changes, and margin reports all speak the same language. Prep-time chaos basically disappeared.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitfield

testimonials.quote: The plate-level costing is what sold our CFO. We finally know which delivery brands actually make money at 11pm on a Tuesday, and we killed two that never did.
testimonials.name: Marcus Feld

testimonials.quote: Reconciling marketplace payouts used to eat one full week every month. Lardr matched the deposits automatically and surfaced $40k in missing adjustments in the first quarter.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman

pricing.blurb: For single-facility operators standing up their first delivery-only brands.
For multi-location operators running a portfolio of brands at scale.
For franchisors and national operators with committed order volume.

homepage.footerBlurb: Lardr is the operating layer for enterprise ghost kitchens — routing, menus, and margin in one honest system of record.
